note.codeData: The chart builder works with datasets added in this form. This chart's data comes from code.
note.noData: Add data to this chart's datasets first, then build the chart from it.
note.written: The chart is now in the spec field.
note.scripts: The chart builder's scripts aren't loaded.
title: Build a chart from data
problem: The builder can't open the spec that's in the field: %(problem)s.
problemHelp: You can start a new chart from the data instead. The spec in the field is only replaced if you choose “Use this chart” and confirm.
confirm: This replaces the spec that's in the field now.
suggestionsHelp: Start from a chart that suits the data's columns. It replaces the chart type and fields below.
arrangement: Bars or areas that share a position
arrangementHint.bar: Choose a colour field to split the bars into parts.
arrangementHint.area: Choose a colour field to split the areas into parts.
point: Show a point for each value
donut: Donut (leave a hole in the middle)
tooltip: Show values in a tooltip on hover or focus
keptIntro: The builder doesn't edit these parts of the spec. They're kept as they are:
droppedIntro: Your changes remove these parts of the spec:
sort.ascending: Ascending (A to Z, low to high)
sort.descending: Descending (Z to A, high to low)
channel.column: Columns (a small chart for each value)
channel.row: Rows (a small chart for each value)
problem.vega: it's a Vega spec, and the builder makes Vega-Lite charts
problem.composite: it combines several views (it has “%(key)s”), and the builder makes one view at a time
problem.mark: the builder doesn't offer its mark type, “%(mark)s”
problem.data: it doesn't load its data from one of the chart's datasets by name
suggest.lines: Lines: %(y)s over time, one for each %(color)s
openedMissing: Opened the field's chart. It used the dataset “%(missing)s”, which this chart doesn't have, so it now uses “%(name)s”.
openedCode: Opened the field's chart. It uses “%(missing)s”, whose data comes from code and can't be previewed here, so the builder shows it with “%(name)s”. Using the chart switches it to “%(name)s”.
started: Started from a suggested chart. Change anything below.
startedFresh: Started a new chart from a suggestion.
cantOpen: The builder can't open this spec.
datasetFields: “%(name)s” doesn't have the fields the chart used, so it starts from a suggestion.
widthAuto: Width set to automatic: charts split into rows or columns can't fill the page width.
swapped: Swapped the X and Y axes.
invalid: This chart can't be used as it is:
previewError: The preview can't be drawn yet: %(error)s
sampled: The preview shows the first %(shown)s of %(total)s rows. The chart on the page uses them all.
error.scripts: The data editor's scripts aren't loaded.
